decisions.reason: Although this plugin is close to the firm's existing webshop capabilities, its disappearance from the website soon after launch signals weak market traction or low strategic priority, so management should reallocate learning and development capacity to stronger extensions and core services.

This ERP interface plugin builds directly on the firm's established integration knowledge, and its promotion to a dedicated page suggests positive early results that the firm can further exploit through its in-house development and client experience.
